title.narrative: Forum des Femmes Autochtones Du Cameroun

description.narrative: FFAC's mission is to advance the rights of indigenous girls and young women in Cameroon, particularly in Mbororo communities. The Equality Fund will support their core operational costs, including staff salaries and office rent, as well as the following activities: - Leadership development of girls and young women, building skills and capacity through workshops led by/for girls/young women - Mobilizing advocacy, emergency and rehabilitation services to address women's and girls' access to education, and resistance against discrimination and violence, including child marriage and unwanted pregnancies. - Training of staff and volunteers to build capacity in report writing, project management and MEL. - Development of digital and print communications to expand the organizational reach of FFAC and rights awareness outreach, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic.
